clue.text: One whose labours should be better rewarded

definitions.text: One whose labours should be better rewarded

parts.words: One whose labours should be better rewarded
parts.note: a plain description of a toiler who earns too little for the effort put in

explanation.definitionFit: Someone whose wages fall short of the value of their toil is exactly this kind of employee.

clue.text: The hold we had against the French in the Napoleonic wars

definitions.text: The hold we had against the French in the Napoleonic wars

parts.words: The hold we had against the French in the Napoleonic wars
parts.note: reads as Britain's grip on France, but points both to a wrestling grip and to the admiral who beat the French fleet

explanation.surface: A history lesson about Britain's advantage over Napoleon's France.
explanation.walkthrough: A nelson is a wrestling hold, and Admiral Nelson was Britain's great naval commander against the French, victor at Trafalgar.
explanation.definitionFit: The wrestling grip and the admiral share the name, so one word covers both senses.

clue.text: Evidently not some West country domain

parts.note: the opposite of West is East, abbreviated E
a country is a state

explanation.surface: Remarks that a certain landholding plainly lies outside the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evidently' is a link. The West Country is the English south-west; the clue splits it so that 'not West' gives E (East) and 'country' gives STATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A landed property or domain is an estate, as in a country house with its grounds.

clue.text: Father's hair stands on end makes him a social outcast

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

indicators.note: in a down clue, a word standing on end is read from the bottom up, so backwards

parts.note: taken as a synonym of itself: the word hair

explanation.surface: Dad's hair bristles with fright, and that turns him into someone shunned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stands on end' turns HAIR into RIAH, written after PA; 'makes him' is the link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcast shunned by society is a pariah.

clue.text: Background notes?

parts.note: looks like briefing material, but means musical notes played in the background of a play or film

explanation.definitionFit: Music written to accompany a play or film, played behind the action, is this.

clue.text: It holds on when certain confusion is about

indicators.note: is about tells us the muddled letters go around the word on
confusion signals that the letters of certain are muddled

explanation.surface: Something keeps its grip whenever doubt and confusion are around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is a link. The anagram of CERTAIN split as C...TAINER goes around ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A box or jar is something that holds things: a receptacle.

clue.text: Specially equipped marine investigator who declines to go to bed

definitions.text: Specially equipped marine investigator who declines to go to bed

parts.words: Specially equipped marine investigator who declines to go to bed
parts.note: declines suggests refusing, but means going down, and the bed is the sea bed, not one for sleeping

explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer with mask and breathing gear who descends to explore the sea floor is this.

clue.text: Circular adornments allowed in pairs

indicators.note: in tells us the word for allowed goes inside the word for pairs

parts.note: a brace is a pair, so pairs are braces
to let is to allow, so allowed is let

explanation.surface: Ring-shaped ornaments that may be worn two at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bands worn round the wrist are ornaments shaped as a circle.

clue.text: See 1
Piece of kitchen equipment subsequently put into a bundle

indicators.note: put into tells us the word for subsequently goes inside the word for bundle

parts.note: a pack is a bundle
subsequently means later

explanation.surface: A kitchen item that was later packed up in a parcel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rack for drying or storing dishes is kitchen equipment.

clue.text: A pick-me-up free from stress in the world of music

definitions.text: free from stress in the world of music

parts.note: a tonic is a restorative drink or medicine

explanation.surface: A restorative that lets musicians relax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' looks like worry, but here means accent or emphasis; in prosody and music an unaccented syllable or beat is called atonic.
explanation.definitionFit: Unaccented or unstressed is the technical meaning, used of syllables and in music.

clue.text: One-sided views we may get from people on holiday

definitions.text: One-sided views we may get from people on holiday

parts.words: One-sided views we may get from people on holiday
parts.note: one-sided views sounds like biased opinions, but means pictures printed on one side of a card mailed by travellers

explanation.definitionFit: Cards with a scenic picture on one face, mailed home by travellers, are these.

clue.text: If all I gathered is due from my son

indicators.note: gathered signals the letters are collected together and rearranged

explanation.surface: From what I've heard, all this is owed to me by my boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Duty owed by a son or daughter to a parent is called this.

clue.text: Estimated cost of a job put into inverted commas?

definitions.meaning: a builder's priced estimate for doing work
a passage of words cited and set between quote marks

explanation.surface: A builder's estimate presented in quotation marks.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a tradesman's price estimate and a cited extract go by the same name, a quote.

clue.text: Not a realist, as Omar Khayyam was when darkness fell

definitions.meaning: a dreamer or idealist with head in the clouds

definitions.text: as Omar Khayyam was when darkness fell
definitions.meaning: the Persian poet was also an astronomer, watching the heavens at night

explanation.surface: Contrasts a dreamer with the poet of the Rubaiyat at nightfall.
explanation.walkthrough: Omar Khayyam, author of the Rubaiyat, was a mathematician and astronomer.
explanation.definitionFit: A daydreamer and an astronomer both get the label of one who looks at the heavens.

clue.text: It goes round making singular admissions

definitions.text: It goes round making singular admissions

parts.words: It goes round making singular admissions
parts.note: singular admissions sounds like odd confessions, but means letting people in one at a time through a rotating gate

explanation.definitionFit: A revolving barrier that lets one person through at a time is this.

clue.text: An insect, since lost

indicators.note: lost tells us the letters of the word since are taken away from the word insect, whatever their order

explanation.surface: An insect that has gone missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' removes the letters S, I, N, C, E from INSECT, leaving T, which goes after AN; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The ant is a familiar small insect.

clue.text: A ship that could be laden with freight for journeys inland

definitions.text: that could be laden with freight for journeys inland

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: Describes a vessel that might carry cargo upriver.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a ship's cargo, but the animal is a pack beast, a 'ship' that carries loads overland.
explanation.definitionFit: The donkey is a beast of burden, carrying packs on overland trips.

clue.text: Turn up at ten for duty, maybe

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means reading from the bottom upwards, so backwards

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Report at ten o'clock to begin your shift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn up' makes AT into TA; 'for' is a link; 'maybe' marks duty as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A duty is one kind of levy charged by government, for example on imports.

clue.text: Wrong information from the bank? Don't you believe it!

definitions.text: Wrong information from the bank? Don't you believe it!

parts.words: Wrong information from the bank? Don't you believe it!
parts.note: plays on a bank statement: one with errors would be a false account, and don't believe it says it is a lie

explanation.definitionFit: A lie or false assertion is a declaration that is not true.

clue.text: Small instrument used for trimming slates

definitions.meaning: a shortened name for the saxophone
a roofer's hatchet-like tool for cutting and holing slates

explanation.surface: A little tool a roofer uses to cut slates down to size.
explanation.definitionFit: The short form of saxophone also names the slater's cutting tool.

clue.text: Reagan in the seat of power

indicators.note: in tells us Reagan's first name goes inside the word the

parts.note: taken as written
Ronald Reagan, the US president, is Ron for short

explanation.surface: President Reagan occupying the seat of power.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch's ceremonial chair stands for royal power.

clue.text: A new trend of fervid intensity

indicators.note: new signals the letters of trend are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A fashion that has caught on with passionate force.
explanation.definitionFit: Passionate and burning with zeal; fervid and eager are synonyms.

clue.text: From the sound of it could be silver spirit

indicators.note: tells us we want a word pronounced like another

parts.note: silver is one example of a metal

explanation.surface: Suggests silver might be a kind of ghost when heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Courage and spirit, as in showing your mettle, is the meaning.

clue.text: Corrupt passage

explanation.surface: A dishonest route through the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb meaning pollute and the noun for a narrow gorge share one spelling.

clue.text: Spruced up collection of trades men

indicators.note: collection of signals that the letters are gathered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A group of workmen all tidied up.
explanation.walkthrough: The page's 'mel' is an OCR slip for 'men'; the letters of TRADESMEN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Spruced up and tidied mean made neat and smart.

clue.text: Retrograde art takes on its characteristics

indicators.note: retrograde means moving backwards, so the word art is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Backward-looking art adopts its own distinctive features.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retrograde' turns ART into TRA; 'takes on' is a link joining ITS after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Features or qualities of character are synonyms.

clue.text: No less sure to find out

definitions.meaning: equally confident, read as two words
to discover or establish for certain

explanation.surface: Equally confident of discovering the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link. Split as AS CERTAIN, the answer means no less sure.
explanation.definitionFit: To establish or discover a fact is to determine it.

clue.text: Only absorbing physical education in public

indicators.note: absorbing tells us the word only takes in the abbreviation

explanation.surface: Doing gym lessons only where everyone can see.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in the open, without concealment, is in public view.

clue.text: Diffuse sort of screed about a tee-totaller

indicators.note: about tells us the jumbled letters go round A and the abbreviation
sort of signals the letters of screed are sorted into a new order

parts.note: TT is the abbreviation for teetotal or a teetotaller

explanation.surface: A long rambling text written about someone who never drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of SCREED, as SC...ERED, goes around A + TT.
explanation.definitionFit: Diffuse, meaning spread out widely, matches dispersed.
